title: Introduce cost posture orchestrator and minibatch inspector
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds a small orchestration service and CLI to synthesize tenant-level cost posture defaults and a minibatch inspector that samples live traffic to validate batch/cache/quant profiles against unit-econ targets. Motivation: customers repeatedly hit suboptimal defaults for low-volume tenants and edge workloads; we need a lightweight automation loop that recommends safe defaults and validates them against production signals before wide rollout. This change introduces: 1) cost-posture-orch service (golang) that compiles tenant signals into prioritized profile suggestions; 2) minibatch-inspector (python) that pulls sampled traces and computes per-tenant unit-econ deltas for candidate batch/cache/quant presets; 3) a small decision model and rules engine (~30 rules) used to flag unsafe recommendations; 4) CLI 'rwcpo' to run dry-runs and export suggested presets as YAML; 5) telemetry hooks and dashboards for the unit-econ probe. Includes migration path and safety: suggestions are only written to a staging namespace by default; rollout requires a separate apply step or an automated canary via the console. Testing: unit tests for rules and decision graph, integration tests against a local runtime shim, and an e2e smoke harness used in CI. Rollout: staged canary (10 tenants) for 48 hours, monitor unit-econ delta < 5% and tail latency within SLOs. Checklist: ensure infra team creates secrets for sampling, update ops runbooks, inform SRE on dashboards. Related: ENG-4821 tracks improvement to tenant defaults; SUP-1347 is a customer incident that motivated the work.

review_comments: Riley Chen: Suggest decoupling the scoring from concrete hardware assumptions; favor normalized cost units. Can you add a normalization layer?
Asha Patel: Reply: added cost-normalizer in commit b3d9c7a; updated tests to cover AMX and non-AMX instances.
Marcus Li: Perf note: the inspector's sampling loop could spike worker threads under very high tenant cardinality. Recommend a bounded worker pool or backpressure.
Asha Patel: Reply: implemented worker pool and adaptive backoff in c7d12f4; added integration test to validate max concurrency.
Priya Nair: Security: ensure sampled traces redact PII and secrets. Please confirm sanitizer behavior.
Asha Patel: Reply: minibatch-inspector now runs the redaction sanitizer and emits only aggregated metrics by default; see tools/minibatch-inspector/samplers/README for config.
Marcus Li: Approve after minor nits fixed.
